No discrepancy found after a clause-by-clause comparison of `SM.treeCoefficient_reversal_shift_law` against the printed prop:A-reversal (sm-2-amplitude.tex 1508-1519) and its supporting definitions.

(1) Shift convention: Polygon.lean:22-23 `def shift (k) (P) := fun i => P (i + k)`, so `shift 1 P i = P (i + 1)`, i.e. vertex i of σP is μ_{i+1}; source def:polygon line 30 "(\sigma P)_i=\mu_{i+1}". It is σ, not σ^{-1}.

(2) Reversal: Reversal.lean:11 `def reversal (P) := fun i => P (2 - i)`; source def:shift line 400 "(\overline P)_i=\mu_{2-i}". The theorem's middle conjunct `∀ i : ZMod n, reversal P i = P (2 - i)` is an additional conclusion (rfl via `reversal_apply`) recording the printed "With \overline P_i=\mu_{2-i}"; it is not a hypothesis and does not weaken the statement.

(3) Clause (i) orientation: Lean `treeCoefficient (shift 1 P) (g1_shift_forward 1 hP) g hn = treeCoefficient P hP (g + 1) hn` puts root g on σP and root g+1 on P, exactly as printed "A_g(\sigma P)=A_{g+1}(P)". Consistency with def:root ("the shift carries the root g of P to the root g-1 of \sigma P"): the boundary word of (σP,g) at k is (σP)_{g+k+1} = μ_{g+k+2} = position k of (P,g+1), as the source proof states (lines 1523-1525: "the boundary vertex at position k of (σP,g) is μ_{g+2+k}, which is precisely position k of (P,g+1)"). Equivalently (P,g) ↔ (σP,g-1), which is the helper `boundaryWord_shift : boundaryWord (shift a P) (g - a) = boundaryWord P g` (RootBoundary.lean:22-23). Both agree; no reversal of sides.

(4) Clause (ii): Lean `treeCoefficient (reversal P) (g1_reversal_forward hP) (1 - g) hn = (-1) ^ n * treeCoefficient P hP g hn`. Root `1 - g` is g^∨ = 1 - g; `(-1)^n : ℤ` uses the implicit `n : ℕ` of `LabelledTuple n = ZMod n → Plane`, the number of vertices, i.e. the printed n. Source proof confirms E_{g^∨}(P̄) runs from μ_{g+1} to μ_g (lines 1529-1531), matching `edge_reversal : edge (reversal P) i = -edge P (1 - i)`.

(5) treeCoefficient = def:treesum: `boundaryIndex g k = g + k.val + 1` gives a_k = μ_{g+k+1} (RootBoundary.lean:8-12; source lines 17-18); `BoundaryInterval`/`IntervalComposition` over `Fin n` (positions 0..N=n-1), parts ≥ 1, strictly monotone cuts with fixed endpoints (RootBoundary.lean:48-68; source lines 21-25); `nearSign` = χ(a_{r_{k+1}}, a_{r_k}, a_{r_{k-1}}), `farSign` = χ(a_j, a_{r_k}, a_i) (Gates.lean:35-43; source def:gates) with `chi P i j k = sign (det (P j - P i) (P k - P i))` (Chirotope.lean:10-11; def:chirotope line 66 and def:gates χ(x,y,z)=sgn det(y-x,z-x)); `ordinaryGate d h = d * signTheta (-h*d)`, `rootGate d h = d * signTheta (h*d)`, `signTheta s = if s = 1 then 1 else 0` (Gates.lean:12-22), matching V^± and Θ(1)=1, Θ(-1)=0 (consistent with lem:gates-nonzero's (d∓h)/2); `openTreeRec` = 1 when leaves = 1 else -Σ_{2 ≤ parts} V^+ ∏ b (TreeCoefficient.lean:15-21; source b-recursion); `rootedTreeRec` = Σ over all compositions of V^- ∏ b including the one-part term (TreeCoefficient.lean:24-27); `fullBoundaryInterval hn = [0, n-1]` (TreeCoefficient.lean:42-45; N = n-1).

(6) Hypotheses: `[NeZero n]` (typeclass, implied by `hn : 3 ≤ n`), `hn : 3 ≤ n` (source standing assumption "Let n ≥ 3", def:polygon line 28), `hP : G1 P` (printed "(G1)"; Generic.lean:11-12 matches def:generic (G1) "χ_{ijk}(P) ≠ 0 for all pairwise distinct i,j,k"), `g : ZMod n` unrestricted (printed "every root g", "indices read modulo n"). The (G1) witnesses `g1_shift_forward 1 hP` (Generic.lean:25-26) and `g1_reversal_forward hP` (GenericReversal.lean:45) take only `hP`. No `Nontrivial`, no extra root or polygon conditions. Nothing is vacuous.

(7) Representative vs orbit: the source's formalization remark (sm-1-polygons 55-61) allows working with labelled tuples throughout, and def:treesum is defined on a representative with a root index, so `LabelledTuple n` is the right type.

(8) No shadowing: grep over all SM modules except the two forbidden files finds exactly one declaration each of `shift`, `reversal`, `treeCoefficient`, `g1_shift_forward`, `g1_reversal_forward`; a second `SM.`-namespace declaration in the forbidden files would be a redeclaration error. I did not open ReversalShiftLaw.lean or TreeReversal.lean, per the brief. Minor brief inaccuracy: `Generic/G1Consequences.lean` does not exist; `g1_shift_forward` lives in `Generic.lean`, and `SM/G1Consequences.lean` has no competing declaration.
